text: Tuma kala kadi nde mi noddi ɓe e ko ɓe haforantee junuubi : wano rewugol Ma An tun, ɗofto Maa An e Nulaaɗo Maa on, ɓe uddira noppi maɓɓe ɗin kollin ɗin fii wata ɓe nanu, ɓe buumora comci maɓɓe ɗin fii wata ɓe yi'am, ɓe duumii e sirkugol ngol, ɓe townitanii jaɓugol noddaandu am ndun, mawnintinanoo ndu.
